title: fix(i18n): every count label a word agrees with is an i18next count family in all ten packs — no `=== 1` key switch, no `*Plural` / `*One` pair (objectui#11445)
body:
Fixes #11445

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Every count label a word must agree with is now an i18next count family, in all ten packs. No component chooses a plural key itself any more.

- **68 keys become families.** 15 code-selected pairs (`xxxCountOne` / `xxxCountPlural`, chosen on `=== 1`) and 53 single-form count keys. Each pack spells every CLDR category its language selects: `en` `_one` / `_other`, `ru` `_one` / `_few` / `_many` / `_other`, `ar` all six, and the others whatever `Intl.PluralRules` selects. Base values are unchanged, so `check:i18n-drift` reads 0 `en` values changed, and the base still answers a call made without a count.
- **The 15 siblings leave all ten packs.** The components call `t(key, { count })`, and every `=== 1` key switch is gone. Eight call sites passed `count: String(n)`, which i18next does not plural-select; they pass the number now. These are the four collaboration count labels, the three collaboration relative timestamps, and the import wizard's auto-match summary. The `page:tabs` badge passes the number below 1000; a shortened `1.2k` stays a string, so it reads the count-invariant base key.
- **The provider-less paths read families the way i18next does.** `createSafeTranslation`'s `fallbackT`, and the gantt and import-wizard hand-rolled fallbacks, look up `key_CATEGORY` (English rules) for a numeric `count`, then the base row. Without this, retiring the pairs would have regressed provider-less hosts from "1 reply" to "1 replies". The defaults tables carry each converted family's `_one` / `_other` rows where English differs.
- **The pin.** The new `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/count-families-11445.test.ts` sits beside the objectui#11432 pin. It fails in two cases:
  - (a) any pack holds a `…Plural` key;
  - (b) any `{{count}}` leaf, in any pack, is outside a family and not on its count-neutral list. Each list entry carries its reason.

  The list can only shrink: every entry must still exist, still interpolate `{{count}}` and still sit outside a family. objectui#11432's two pins judge the 68 new families by construction, for slot existence and i18next selection.

## Premise check, on current `main`

The card's measurement reproduces at `89cad75d5`, the first cut, and again at `37140f4f5` after merging `main` (plain i18next 26.4.0 over the shipped packs, emulating each call site's `=== 1` switch):

- `ru` `detail.attachmentCount`: `3 вложений`, `21 вложений`. `ru` `detail.replyCount`: `21 ответов`.
- `ar` `detail.attachmentCount`: `2 مرفقات`, `100 مرفقات`. `ar` `detail.replyCount`: `11 ردود`.
- `ru` at 3: `Согласовать 3 запросов?`, `Импортировать 3 строк`, `3 строк изменено`, `3 ожидающих утверждений`. `en`: `2 row modified`.

The card's "the defective set needs a per-key read" held, and the population is larger than its sample. At the merge base, 130 `{{count}}` leaves sat outside the 14 families. Read pack by pack, with each call site's reachable range:

- 68 needed a family. A word agreed with the number in at least one pack, often `de`, `es`, `pt` or `fr` at 1, or `ar` with a full noun.
- 48 are count-neutral.
- 15 were siblings that retire.
- 1 is not a count.

The census enumerates every `t(…, { count })` call site: 158 literal-key sites. 109 now reach a family and 47 reach a count-neutral key. The other 2 are scanner false matches: a variable named `count` passed as `total`, and a key named `report.aggregate.count`. No call site passes `count` to a key without a hole or a family.

The count-neutral reasons, as the pin states them:
- `tally`: the number stands alone, so nothing agrees with it. It sits in parentheses, after `+`, beside `/ {{total}}`, or after a label or verb.
- `invariant`: every pack phrases the label count-invariantly. That means an `(s)` marker in en/de/fr/es/pt (the convention `perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx` pins), a label, partitive or impersonal form in ru/ar, and a counter in zh/ja/ko.
- `abbreviated`: a relative time with an abbreviated unit in every pack.
- `twoOrMore`: the call site renders the label only at 2 or more. Every pack's form is right at every such count: the cross-page banner needs `totalMatching` above `pageSize`, and the inbox group header needs a group of two.
- `unreached`: no `t()` caller; `check:i18n-dead-keys` lists each one.

## Reverse verification and ablation

Each prediction was written before its run.

- **The fix at the merge base, this branch's tests at HEAD.** The 31 source files were set to their `37140f4f5` blobs (31 of 31 confirmed by hash), and 7 test files were run.
  - Predicted 65 failing tests in 5 files: count-families 3, `useSafeTranslation` 5, countLabels-10242 16, countLabels-10425 29, SearchResultsPage-10024 12. Predicted `plural-categories-11432` and `all-locales-key-parity` green.
  - Observed `Test Files 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`, `Tests 65 failed | 123 passed (188)`, split exactly as predicted.
  - The pin printed `` 30 `…Plural` key(s) `` (3 keys in 10 packs), `82 count label(s) outside any family` (68 bases and the 14 siblings that interpolate `{{count}}`), and `expected 14 to be greater than or equal to 82`.
  - Restore: each blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty with 0 porcelain lines.
- **Ablations at HEAD**, through `ablation-replace.mjs`: each anchor must hit once, each write is verified on disk, and each restore is proven by blob hash.
  - B, `ru` `detail.attachmentCount_few` deleted. Predicted 2 failing. Observed `Tests 2 failed | 60 passed (62)`: parity's `ru: 1 plural slot(s) missing: [ 'detail.attachmentCount_few' ]`, and the i18next pin's `ru: 1 slot(s) not selected`. The new pin stayed green, as predicted.
  - C1, `perm.facet.more` taken off the count-neutral list. Predicted 1 failing. Observed `Tests 1 failed | 61 passed`: `1 count label(s) outside any family`.
  - C2, `detail.attachmentCountPlural` planted back into `en`. Predicted 11 failing. Observed `Tests 11 failed | 51 passed`: the pin's `` 1 `…Plural` key(s): [ 'en:detail.attachmentCountPlural' ] ``, its outside-a-family case, and parity's "defines every en key" for 9 packs.
  - Every leg restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), and the tree reads 0 porcelain lines afterwards. Every subject resolves to `src` through relative imports or the vitest `@object-ui/*` aliases, so no `dist` build or preflight applies.

The type-check ran over the 11 packages at `e8d09bfda`. Its outer `timeout` then cut the app-shell leg, which was re-run alone and exited 0. The TypeScript tree is byte-identical at the head. `--listFiles` counts all 9 changed i18n test files in that package's test program.

**eslint over the 54 changed lintable files.** With the packages' own `eslint .` (inline config honoured): 0 errors and 611 warnings, none of them on a line this branch adds (cross-checked against `git diff -U0`). With `--no-inline-config`: 1 error, `react-hooks/static-components` in `data-table.tsx`, on a line this branch does not touch. Linting the base blob through `--stdin` gives the same error, from an `eslint-disable-next-line` the flag ignores.

The narrowing is proven three ways:
1. Every file is in the linted population: eslint's JSON reports 54 files and no "File ignored" message.
2. The file count comes from that JSON.
3. `eslint.config.js` turns on no type-aware linting (no `project` / `projectService` / `TypeChecked`), and no local rule reads another file. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **The measured renders.** CONFIRMED: the card's renders reproduce on current `main`; before/after above.
2. **Count-neutral needs a per-key read.** CONFIRMED, and wider. The enumeration is the census above, and the defective set is 68 keys, not the card's measured sample of six. Many single forms were wrong outside `ru` / `ar`: `es` / `pt` participles at 1, `de` adjectives and verbs at 1, `ar` full nouns in relative times.
3. **The pin.** DONE, as a sibling test, not a gate script. ⚠️ FALSIFIED: "the list stays small". The count-neutral list holds 48 keys under 5 reasons. Each reason is true in all ten packs, and converting any one of those keys would only repeat one string across its slots.
4. **Callers.** CONFIRMED and fixed: 8 call sites passed a string `count`, which i18next does not plural-select; they now pass a number. No caller used another name. The defaults maps carry the families' rows, and `createSafeTranslation` and the two hand-rolled fallbacks read them.
5. **`en` single-form values.** DONE. Each converted `en` value gets real `_one` / `_other` forms (`2 rows modified`, `1 pending approval`). The base is unchanged, so `check:i18n-drift` sees no `en` value move.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- **`check:i18n-dead-keys` lists six new slot keys as `[confirmed]`.** They are `fields.relativeDate.overdue_one` / `_other`, `notifications.arrivalMany_one` / `_other` and `notifications.arrivalRepeats_one` / `_other`, and all six are false positives. The census adds suffix spellings only for a call site it parses as a pack `t()`. These two families are reached through `translate(…)` (`useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts`) and `options.t?.(key, …)` with the key in a const (`date-display.ts`); their base keys were already found by the text probe.
